envelope.description: Name the gate behind every content writer in the write inventory

body.title: Name the gate behind every content writer in the write inventory
body.summary: Add the optional gatedBy field to InventoryEntry and WriteSite in src/workflow/artifact-write-inventory.ts (an entry point name, or an object with an exemption reason), fill it for the eight content places (synthesize.ts, workflow-rpc.ts, resolve-comment.ts, unit-head.ts, standalone-record.ts, test-record.ts, task-set.ts and the appendStoryToDefine site), and add the test in src/workflow/__tests__/artifact-write-inventory.test.ts that fails for a content entry or site with neither.
acceptanceChecks: every content entry and site names a gate or an exemption with a reason
the test fails for a content writer with neither, shown by a fixture entry
appendStoryToDefine is recorded as gated by finalizeDefineExtend and resolve-comment.ts by handleResolveComment
the existing inventory rules still pass

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/artifact-write-inventory.test.ts: every content entry and site names a gatedBy entry point or an exemption with a reason, including appendStoryToDefine
src/workflow/__tests__/artifact-write-inventory.test.ts: a content writer with neither a gate nor an exemption is reported
